Refund Policy

Last updated: November 10, 2026

Please contact us first

If you experience a service issue, contact IPTV4USA support on WhatsApp before requesting a refund. Our team will make reasonable efforts to troubleshoot account and setup concerns.

Eligibility review

Refund requests are reviewed individually. Eligibility may depend on the nature of the issue, the time since purchase, whether access details were delivered and whether support had an opportunity to resolve a technical problem.

Exclusions

We cannot guarantee refunds for device incompatibility where compatibility guidance was available, issues caused by a customer’s internet connection or device configuration, or use after service credentials have been fully delivered.

How to request review

Send your order details and a clear description of the issue to WhatsApp. We will review and respond with the available resolution.
